papers.title: A Unified Dual SDP–Procrustes Manifold Optimization Framework with Theoretical Breakthroughs
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel optimization framework that organically integrates the ideas of dual semidefinite programming (DDP) and the Procrustes problem, constructing a unified matrix optimization model. This method not only inherits the convex optimization advantage of dual SDP under global constraints but also introduces the geometric constraints of the Procrustes mapping, achieving high-precision alignment optimization on low-dimensional manifolds. papers.title: Sphere-Constrained Dual Semidefinite Programming: A Novel Optimization Framework
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel optimization method combining dual semidefinite programming (Dual SDP) and unit sphere constraints. Traditional dual SDP optimization is often used for linear matrix inequalities and convex optimization problems, while sphere constraints are commonly used for vector normalization and non-convex optimization scenarios. papers.title: Primal-Dual Manifold Newton Method for Semidefinite Programming: Theory and Applications
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel optimization method that deeply integrates Dual Semidefinite Programming (DDP) with the Manifold Newton Method, constructing a Primal-Dual Newton Flow on Manifolds for dual semidefinite optimization. Compared with traditional SDP and manifold optimization methods, this method achieves second-order convergence while ensuring global convergence. papers.title: Dual Orthogonality Constrained Semidefinite Programming: Theory and Algorithms
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel optimization framework—Dual Orthogonality Constrained Semidefinite Programming (DOC-SDP)—which organically combines dual semidefinite programming with orthogonal constraints to accelerate convergence and preserve structure of the primal optimization problem in the dual space. papers.title: A Unified Dual SDP and Lie Group Flow Optimization Framework
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a novel optimization theoretical framework that organically integrates dual semidefinite programming (Dual SDP) with Lie group optimization methods to construct a class of optimization flows based on continuous dynamical systems.
